title: BNPL Diamond: Concierge Dispute Support, Response Times, and What to Expect
summary: This document describes BNPL Diamond’s Concierge Dispute Support: it is enabled (“Yes”) and provides an initial response within 36 hours from first contact. It explains triage/acknowledgement, evidence documentation requests, specialist case handling with periodic status updates, and a written outcome with next steps (including any credits/adjustments when applicable). If not enabled, disputes follow the standard support workflow and the 36-hour target doesn’t apply.
